edges.reason: msg.sender from the deployer becomes the privileged owner during construction.
The Owned constructor executes the owner assignment.
Owner state variable is written with the caller-controlled address.
Constructor initializes the owner storage slot.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require.
proposeOwner is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier check.
Parameter feeds the proposeOwner function body.
Caller-supplied address is stored as proposedOwner.
proposeOwner writes the proposedOwner state variable.
msg.sender must equal proposedOwner to execute the ownership change.
claimOwnership performs the privileged owner reassignment.
Owner storage is overwritten from proposedOwner.
proposedOwner value flows into the ownership transition.
Deployer address is used for mint recipient, fee exemption and beneficiary.
Constructor calls _msgSender to resolve the deployer.
_msgSender returns msg.sender.
Constructor sets the minSupply threshold.
Constructor initializes feesEnabled to false.
Constructor sets the beneficiary to the deployer address.
Constructor pre-excludes the deployer and router from fees.
Constructor computes the initial total supply local.
Initial supply local is passed to _mint.
Constructor mints the whole supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
sender parameter is used to debit fees and balances.
recipient parameter is validated against the token contract address.
amount parameter drives fee and net transfer arithmetic.
Fee exemption mapping read to decide whether fee logic applies.
minSupply read to decide whether the burn fee is applied.
totalSupply read to compare against minSupply in the fee path.
_transfer calls calculateFee for burn and transfer fees.
calculateFee binds the amount argument.
calculateFee binds the fee basis-point argument.
Amount multiplies the fee in the fee formula.
Fee rate participates in the multiplication.
calculateFee executes the multiplication and division.
burnedFee local receives the 25 basis-point fee result.
transferFee local receives the 200 basis-point fee result.
burnedFee is the amount passed to _burn.
_transfer conditionally burns and subtracts from supply.
transferFee is paid out to the beneficiary.
beneficiary address receives the transfer fee.
_transfer performs the beneficiary fee payout via ERC20._transfer.
Fee path calls _burn on the sender.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases the account balance.
_transfer delegates to the base ERC20 transfer for fees and net amount.
ERC20._transfer mutates sender and recipient balances.
Base transfer caches senderBalance before subtraction.
senderBalance is checked and subtracted in the base transfer.
Public burn calls _burn on the caller.
value parameter is burned from the caller balance.
Burn amount flows into _burn and supply reduction.
burn validates total supply against minSupply after burning.
burn resolves the caller via _msgSender.
setMinSupply is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Parameter feeds the setMinSupply function body.
Owner-supplied value overwrites minSupply.
setMinSupply writes the minSupply state variable.
setBeneficiary is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Parameter feeds the setBeneficiary function body.
setBeneficiary calls setExcludeFromFee for the new beneficiary.
New beneficiary is auto-excluded from fees.
setBeneficiary overwrites the beneficiary address.
setFeesEnabled is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Parameter feeds the setFeesEnabled function body.
setFeesEnabled toggles the feesEnabled flag.
setExcludeFromFee is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Account parameter feeds the setExcludeFromFee function body.
Exclusion flag parameter feeds the setExcludeFromFee function body.
setExcludeFromFee writes the fee exemption mapping.
Public transfer delegates to the transfer logic.
transferFrom first moves tokens through the transfer logic.
transferFrom reads and rewrites the allowance mapping.
currentAllowance is checked and reduced in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls _approve to store the reduced allowance.

Amount operand of the fee multiplication inside calculateFee.

Parameter only assigns the beneficiary and fee exemption.
